name: Azerbaijan
description: Azerbaijan from Caucasian Albania and the Shirvanshahs to the Baku oil boom, the first Muslim republic, Soviet rule and independence.

checkpoints.name: Ancient and medieval
checkpoints.note: Caucasian Albania, Persian rule and the Shirvanshahs. Nizami wrote his poems in Ganja.

checkpoints.name: Oil and empire
checkpoints.note: Russia took the north. Oil made Baku rich, and in 1918 the first republic of the Muslim world was declared.

checkpoints.name: Soviet Azerbaijan
checkpoints.note: The Red Army took Baku in 1920. The Soviet years ended in bloodshed in Black January.

checkpoints.name: Independent Azerbaijan
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1991, then war over Karabakh, oil wealth and rule by the Aliyev family.
